'''November 2001 Smyrna tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Smyrna, GA on 3 November 2001. It is known from Damian Loback's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3091">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-04-smyran-ga-11-3-01d3091/ smyran-ga-11-3-01], DeckTech (Damian "Jamintheeye" Loback, 4 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-04-smyran-ga-11-3-01d3091/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Smyrna, GA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
